title: Users unable to login after JWT token refresh
description: Several users reported being logged out automatically after remaining inactive for 15 minutes. Refresh token flow appears broken.
root_cause: Refresh token expiration mismatch between frontend and backend configuration.
investigation_summary: Frontend was requesting refresh using an already expired token because expiry buffer logic was missing.
final_resolution: Added proactive refresh window and aligned backend token expiry configuration.
fix_summary: Updated token refresh middleware and frontend auth interceptor.

comments.author: QA Team
comments.message: Issue reproducible on Chrome and Edge after idle session timeout.

comments.author: Rahul Sharma
comments.message: Backend refresh endpoint rejecting tokens due to strict expiry validation.

title: Redis connection timeout causing delayed notifications
description: Push notifications delayed by 10 to 15 minutes for multiple customers.
stack_trace: Error: Redis connection timeout at RedisClient.connect()
root_cause: Redis connection pool exhausted during traffic spike.
investigation_summary: Traffic surge from scheduled campaigns overloaded Redis connections.
final_resolution: Increased Redis pool size and implemented retry backoff.
fix_summary: Updated redis config and autoscaling rules.
deployment_notes: Redis cluster scaled from 2 to 5 nodes.

comments.author: SRE Team
comments.message: Observed connection saturation during campaign execution.

title: React dashboard failing with hydration mismatch
description: Dashboard widgets flickering during initial page load. Console shows hydration warnings.
stack_trace: Warning: Text content did not match. Server: '0' Client: '12'
error_logs: Hydration failed because initial UI does not match server-rendered HTML.
root_cause: Client-side date formatting produced inconsistent rendering.
investigation_summary: Timezone formatting differed between server and browser rendering.
final_resolution: Moved date formatting to backend and normalized timezone handling.

comments.author: Frontend Lead
comments.message: Hydration mismatch disappears when timezone forced to UTC.

title: Payment gateway returning intermittent 500 errors
description: Customers unable to complete subscription purchase. Payment requests failing intermittently.
stack_trace: AxiosError: Request failed with status code 500
root_cause: Third-party payment provider latency causing request timeout.
investigation_summary: Retry logic missing for delayed gateway acknowledgements.
final_resolution: Added idempotent retries and increased request timeout.

comments.author: Mohit Jain
comments.message: Gateway responding after timeout threshold exceeded.

title: Database deadlock detected during bulk invoice generation
description: Nightly invoice job failed for multiple enterprise accounts.
stack_trace: ERROR: deadlock detected DETAIL: Process 221 waits for ShareLock
root_cause: Concurrent updates on invoice and transaction tables.
investigation_summary: Bulk invoice generation used parallel workers without row ordering.
final_resolution: Introduced transaction ordering and reduced batch concurrency.

comments.author: Dev Malhotra
comments.message: Deadlocks spike during nightly cron execution.

comments.author: DBA Team
comments.message: Recommended adding FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED.

title: Duplicate issue - users unable to login after session timeout
description: Customers reporting forced logout after inactivity. Appears similar to earlier token issue.
investigation_summary: One node had stale environment variables after deployment.
final_resolution: Restarted outdated container and synced environment configs.

comments.author: Rahul Sharma
comments.message: Looks like one pod missed the previous deployment.
